title.rendered: Mardi Himal Trekking Guide: Complete Itinerary, Cost & Travel Tips

content.rendered:
If you are looking for a short yet breathtaking Himalayan adventure, Mardi Himal Trekking is one of the best hidden gems in Nepal. Located in the famous Annapurna Region, this trek offers stunning views of Machapuchare, lush forests, and peaceful trails away from heavy crowds.

This guide will help you plan your journey with a detailed itinerary, inclusions, and essential travel insights for a smooth trekking experience.

Why Choose Mardi Himal Trek?

Mardi Himal Trek is ideal for beginners and experienced trekkers alike. It is shorter than other popular routes but still delivers incredible Himalayan views.

Key Highlights

  • Close-up views of Machapuchare and Annapurna peaks
  • Peaceful trails with fewer tourists
  • Diverse landscapes from forests to alpine terrain
  • Perfect short trek for limited time travelers

 

Mardi Himal Trek Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival

Arrive in Nepal and transfer from the airport to your hotel. Rest and prepare for the adventure ahead.

Day 2: Drive to Pokhara

Travel to Pokhara, a beautiful lakeside city known as the gateway to Annapurna treks.

Day 3: Drive from Pokhara to Kande and Trek to Deurali

Start your journey with a scenic drive to Kande, followed by a trek through forests to Deurali.

Day 4: Trek from Deurali to Rest Camp

Walk through dense rhododendron forests and enjoy peaceful surroundings on your way to Rest Camp.

Day 5: Trek from Rest Camp to High Camp

As you gain altitude, the landscape changes to alpine terrain with breathtaking mountain views.

Day 6: Hike to Mardi Himal Base Camp and Trek to Badal Danda

Early morning hike to Mardi Himal Base Camp for panoramic views, then descend to Badal Danda.

Day 7: Trek to Siding and Drive Back to Pokhara

Descend to Siding village and drive back to Pokhara to relax after your trek.

What’s Included in the Package?

When booking through a reliable tour provider like Gulf Oasis Travels & Tourism, your package typically includes:

  • Airport pick up and drop off
  • Accommodation in Pokhara
  • Trekking permits, including TIMS and ACAP
  • Staff insurance
  • Trekking map
  • Food and lodging during the trek
  • Porter service (2 trekkers share 1 porter)
  • Basic medical kit 

Best Time for Mardi Himal Trek

The best seasons to trek are:

  • Spring from March to May for blooming rhododendrons
  • Autumn from September to November for clear mountain views

Avoid monsoon due to slippery trails and winter if you are not experienced in snow trekking.

Essential Tips for Trekkers

Prepare Physically

Even though it is a moderate trek, basic fitness is important.

Pack Smart

Carry warm clothes, trekking shoes, and essential gear.

Stay Hydrated

Drink plenty of water to avoid altitude related issues.

Follow Safety Guidelines

Always trek with a guide or a trusted company for safety and navigation.

Conclusion

Mardi Himal Trekking offers a perfect combination of adventure, natural beauty, and cultural experience. Whether you are a first time trekker or an experienced explorer, this journey promises unforgettable memories in the heart of the Himalayas.
